_about: Exact settings for the plugins the knowledge base covers: the label as the admin screen shows it, where it is, the stored key (only when a primary source shows it), the plugin versions it was read in, and the official page(s) that say so. Every evidence claim is a phrase that scripts/verify-knowledge.js must find on the cited page (documentation, or the plugin source at a version tag on plugins.svn.wordpress.org). verified=true only after the tool found every claim AND the excerpts were read. A setting is a suggestion to try in the sandbox, not proof; its version range is where it was READ, not a promise for other versions. stored_key is null when no primary source publishes it (WP Rocket is premium and its documentation names labels only).
